title: Zesty Roasted Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Jamaican chicken curry dish featuring yellow curry paste, roasted to perfection and deglazed for a rich and satisfying flavor, perfect for a midnight craving and FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the curry paste, coconut oil, chopped onion, garlic-infused oil, grated ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the curry mixture.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and deglaze the baking sheet with the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the chicken to the baking sheet and continue roasting for an additional 15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the chicken with the deglazed curry sauce spooned over the top.
